<!-- Generated by crates/gridwell-render/tests/feature_matrix.rs; GRIDWELL_BLESS_MATRIX=1 cargo test -p gridwell-render --test feature_matrix rewrites it. Do not edit by hand. -->

Which IR features each Tier-1 writer expresses. Every cell is *measured*: the test renders a probe table, reads the output back with a format-specific reader (cell by cell: weight, slant, decoration, colour, size, font, fill, alignment, borders) and checks the feature is there — and doesn't leak into neighbouring cells. The test fails whenever a measurement disagrees with this page.

✓ supported · ✗ not yet (the format can express it) · ⊘ the format can't (portably) express it. Numbers refer to the notes below.

| Feature | IR | HTML | LaTeX | Typst | RTF | DOCX | XLSX |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| bold | `font_weight: bold` (or ≥ 600) | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| italic | `font_style: italic` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| underline | `text_decoration: underline` | ✓ | ✗<sup>1</sup> | ✗<sup>1</sup> | ✗<sup>1</sup> | ✗<sup>1</sup> | ✗<sup>1</sup> |
| strikethrough | `text_decoration: line-through` | ✓ | ✗<sup>1</sup> | ✗<sup>1</sup> | ✗<sup>1</sup> | ✗<sup>1</sup> | ✗<sup>1</sup> |
| text-color | `color` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| font-size | `font_size` (20px = 15pt) | ✓ | ✗<sup>1</sup> | ✓ | ✗<sup>1</sup> | ✗<sup>1</sup> | ✗<sup>1</sup> |
| font-family | `font_family` (a named family, not just monospace) | ✓ | ⊘<sup>2</sup> | ✗<sup>3</sup> | ✗<sup>1</sup> | ✗<sup>1</sup> | ✗<sup>1</sup> |
| text-transform | `text_transform: uppercase` | ✓ | ✗<sup>1</sup> | ✗<sup>1</sup> | ✗<sup>1</sup> | ✗<sup>1</sup> | ✗<sup>1</sup> |
| fill | `background_color` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| cell-align | `text_align` on a cell | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| column-align | a column's `align` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| vertical-align | `vertical_align: bottom` | ✓ | ✗<sup>1</sup> | ✗<sup>1</sup> | ✗<sup>1</sup> | ✗<sup>1</sup> | ✗<sup>1</sup> |
| border | `border` (2px solid red bottom) | ✓ | ✗<sup>1</sup> | ✗<sup>1</sup> | ✗<sup>1</sup> | ✗<sup>1</sup> | ✓ |
| border-styles | border styles dashed, dotted, double | ✓ | ✗<sup>1</sup> | ✗<sup>1</sup> | ✗<sup>1</sup> | ✗<sup>1</sup> | ✓ |
| column-style | a column's `style_id` (cascades to its cells) | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| row-style | a row's `style_id` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| striping | `row_striping` (every second body row filled) | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| conditional-style | `styles.conditionals` (row parity) | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| style-composition | `styles.compositions` (extends + overrides) | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| styled-run | inline `styled_text` (part of a cell bold) | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✗<sup>4</sup> |
| footnote-mark | footnote marks as superscript | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✗<sup>4</sup> |
| title | `header.title` and `header.subtitle` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| notes | footnotes and source notes | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |

**Notes**

1. not implemented
2. a named system font needs XeLaTeX/LuaLaTeX with fontspec; the output also targets pdfLaTeX (monospace families map to `\texttt`)
3. only monospace families are mapped (to Courier New)
4. cell text is written as one plain run (no rich text)

Structure — spans, hidden columns, stub columns, hidden column labels, group labels and summary rows — is verified separately for every writer by the grid invariant: each output is read back as a grid and compared with the IR's.
